previous.changeLog: Your saved settings survive updates. Bar position, size, and toggles are now preserved when the mod updates its internal settings format, so a new version no longer resets your layout.

current.changeLog: Skill-tree upgrade descriptions read properly again. Some Tier XI upgrades showed raw placeholders such as {value0} in place of their numbers, followed by a bare, unlabelled "+20 / +5". The values are now filled into the sentence and highlighted the way the game's own tooltip does.
